quests.rookie_guard.m02.academy_roof: These stairs lead up to the roof of the academy. Up there you should find TWO of the catapults.
quests.rookie_guard.m02.house_vascalir: This is the house Vascalir mentioned. You should find a stone pile in the cellar. Use it to get a stone!
quests.rookie_guard.m02.norma_bar: This is Norma's bar. If you go to the roof, you should find one of the catapults that need to be filled with stones.
quests.rookie_guard.m02.obi_shop: This is Obi's shop. Up on his roof you should find one of the catapults Vascalir mentioned.
quests.rookie_guard.m04.not_hyacinth_eas: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Follow the path to the east to find Hyacinth's little house.
quests.rookie_guard.m04.not_hyacinth_nor: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Follow the path to the north exit of the village.
quests.rookie_guard.m04.not_hyacinth_sta: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Stay on the path a little more to the north to find Hyacinth's little house.
quests.rookie_guard.m04.not_lily: This is not the way to Lily. Follow the road leading to the south-west to find her shop.
quests.rookie_guard.m05.follow_north: Follow the small path to the north to reach the spider lair.
quests.rookie_guard.m05.not_tarantula_sw: This is not the way to the tarantula's lair. Head up the little ramp to the southwest.
quests.rookie_guard.m05.remember_web: Remember that you have to aquire a web sample for Vascalir. You should not leave this cave without it.
quests.rookie_guard.m05.walk_west: Walk to the west from here to reach the hole leading to the tarantula lair.
quests.rookie_guard.m06.dead_wolf: There is a dead war wolf! Use the knife, and then use it on its body to get some leather - but quickly!
quests.rookie_guard.m06.exit_time: You reached the exit in time! Phew.. back to Tom.
quests.rookie_guard.m06.follow_ne: Follow the north-eastern path into the forest. Beware of wolves!
quests.rookie_guard.m06.not_wolf_stay: This is not the way into the wolf forest. Stay on the southern path leading to the north-east!
quests.rookie_guard.m06.plans_changed: It seems plans changed. It's up to you now to find a dead war wolf and use the skinning knife on it to get some leather.
quests.rookie_guard.m06.poacher_dead: Well.. that seems to be the poacher. Dead. Check his body - maybe he still has something that you can use.
quests.rookie_guard.m06.wolf_den_hole: This hole leads into the wolves' den. Only enter if you have full health and food - this might be dangerous.
quests.rookie_guard.m07.chest_flames: This must be the chest with the book - but it's covered in flames!
quests.rookie_guard.m07.rune_table: Right-click on the grey rune on the table and then left-click on the fire! You can't take the rune, but it works.
quests.rookie_guard.m07.stairs_vault: Go down the stairs to reach the vault. It smells like fire down there. Make sure you are healthy!
quests.rookie_guard.m07.vault_fire: The vault is on fire! There is almost no air in here. You don't have much time to find the book. Hurry!
quests.rookie_guard.m09.not_troll_caves: This is not the way to the troll caves. Go back down the stairs and walk north to find them.
quests.rookie_guard.m09.troll_tunnel: You've reached the newly dug troll tunnel. Take what you find in this chest and use it to bring down all support beams!
quests.rookie_guard.m09.tunnel_collapsed: You hear a crumbling below you. The tunnel collapsed. Vascalir will be pleased to hear about that.
quests.rookie_guard.m10.crypt_explore: This is the crypt Vascalir was talking about. Explore it and search the coffins - one of them must hold a nice fleshy bone.
quests.rookie_guard.m10.deeper_crypt: This door seems to lead deeper into the crypt. Go downstairs and look for a special coffin. Beware of the walking dead!
quests.rookie_guard.m10.fleshy_bone: Now that you have a fleshy bone, it's time to find out what Vascalir wanted with it.
quests.rookie_guard.m10.not_crypt: This is not the way to the crypt. Go south-west to reach the graveyard.
quests.rookie_guard.m10.sarcophagus: This sarcophagus seems special. Sarcophagi are said to conserve meat longer than normal coffins - maybe you get lucky.
quests.rookie_guard.m11.wasp_tower: You've found the wasp tower. Kill a wasp and use the flask you got from Vascalir on its corpse to retrieve some of its poison.
quests.rookie_guard.m11.wasps_nest: Cross the bridge to the west and go south to reach the wasps' nest.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.approaching: Beware... you're approaching Kraknaknork's room. Once you enter, you have only 5 minutes to kill him before he throws you out.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.chest_items: This chest should contain everything you need to infiltrate the fortress.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.distraction_bone: You cannot hope to sneak past this guard. Maybe some distraction would help? You could try using the fleshy bone on him...
quests.rookie_guard.m12.energy_barrier: Kraknaknork maintains strong energy barriers. There is only one way to disable them.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.guard_pass: This guard will definitely not let you pass. Sneak around the fortress to find a way to disguise yourself.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.interior: You've managed to reach the interior of the orc fortress. Be prepared for a fight - and look for the soup cauldron.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.items_infiltrate: Those items should be what you need to infiltrate the fortress. Go back near the wasps' nest and walk south from there.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.kitchen: You're apperently in the kitchen. If you find a big cauldron, use the flask of wasp poison on it.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.lever_barrier: The energy barrier to the south temporarily disappeared.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.no_poison_yet: You haven't used the poison on Kraknaknork's soup yet. Don't try to fight him before that - or he will definitely kill you.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.orc_break: This orc has turned his back to you and is obviously taking a break. Use the rolling pin on him to knock him out!
quests.rookie_guard.m12.sneaked_in: You sneaked into the orc fortress. Careful now, don't go outside again.
quests.rookie_guard.m12.trap_ready: Got your tarantula trap ready? You might need to use it soon...
quests.rookie_guard.missions.bank_academ: The bank is below the academy. Go north and head down the stairs and to the right.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.bank_paulie: Go to the right to find the bank and talk to Paulie.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.graveyard_e: Follow the way to the east and go south to reach the graveyard.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.hallway_lib: Head through the northern door and follow the hallways to find the library vault.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.hyacinth_ea: Follow the path to the east to find Hyacinth's little house.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.library_vau: The library vault is below the academy. Go north and head down several stairs until you find a quest door.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.no_bag_yet: You don't have the bag with the items yet. Open the door in the basement of the academy to the left of Paulie to get them!

quests.rookie_guard.missions.not_tarantu: This is not the way to the tarantula's lair. Head northwest and go up the little ramp.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.not_troll_n: This is not the way to the troll caves. Follow the path to the north past the hill to reach them.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.not_wasps_n: This is not the way to the wasps' lair. Choose the northern path to reach it.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.orc_fortres: Follow the path to the north, cross the bridge to the south and walk west to reach the orc fortress.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.orc_west: Follow the path to the west to reach the orc fortress.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.road_main: This road is the main access of the village. You might want to finish your business here first.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.tarantula_s: Walk to the north and down the stairs to reach the tarantula's lair.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.troll_caves: Follow the path to the north past the hill to reach the troll caves.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.wasps_bridg: To reach the wasps' nests follow the path to the north and cross the bridge to the west as if you wanted to reach the spiders.
Take the southern stairs down the bridge to go to the wasps' lair.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.wasps_west: Follow the path to the west to find the wasps' lair.
quests.rookie_guard.missions.wolf_forest: Follow the path east, and when it splits, head north-east to find the wolf forest.

quests.unnatural_selection.mission2_say_: You hold the skull up high. You can resist the urge to have it look through a telescope though.
That's definitely one of the highest spots in whole Tibia. If that's not simply perfect you don't know what it is.
What a beautiful view. Worthy of a Queen indeed! Time to head back to Lazaran and show him what you got.
You hold up the skull and let it take a peek over the beautiful elven town through the dense leaves.
Thanita gives you a really strange look as you hold up the skull, but oh well.
That was a real easy one. And you are used to getting strange looks now, so whatever!
Wow, it's hot up here. Luckily the skull can't get a sunburn any more, but you can, so you better descend again!
Considering that higher places around here aren't that easy to reach, you think the view from here is tolerably good.
Yep, that's a pretty high spot. If Lazaran ever sees what the skull sees, he'd be pretty satisfied with that nice view.
Well, there are higher spots around here, but none of them is as easily reachable as this one. It just has to suffice.
Nice! White in white as far as the eye can see. Time to leave before your fingers turn into icicles.
